definitions.gloss: increasing sophistication; becoming more elaborate or refined
definitions.explanation: The process of something becoming more intricate, precise, or sophisticated over time. Often used in contexts of technology, craftsmanship, fraud techniques, or design.

examples.japanese: ⟦サイバー→サイバー：28281_saibaa⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{精巧化|せいこうか}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cyber attack methods are becoming increasingly sophisticated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精巧化|せいこうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{偽札|にせさつ}→偽札：16634_nisesatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the increasing sophistication of counterfeiting technology, it has become harder to detect fake bills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精巧化|せいこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: While products are becoming more sophisticated, repair costs are also rising.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{精巧|せいこう}→精巧：03775_seikou⟧ (elaborate/exquisite) and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation/-ization). The suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ indicates a process of change or becoming. Often appears in news and technical writing about evolving threats, technologies, or techniques.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精巧化|せいこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: sophistication advances
- {精巧化|せいこうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become more sophisticated
- ⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精巧化|せいこうか}: increasing sophistication of methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高度化|こうどか}→高度化：21279_koudoka⟧: advancement/becoming more advanced — broader scope
- ⟦{巧妙化|こうみょうか}→巧妙化：20759_koumyouka⟧: becoming more cunning — carries a negative nuance (trickery)
- ⟦{複雑化|ふくざつか}→複雑化：21265_fukuzatsuka⟧: becoming more complex — focuses on complexity rather than refinement
- ⟦{精巧|せいこう}→精巧：03775_seikou⟧: elaborate/exquisite — the base adjective
